errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that the figure consists of two separate, side-by-side bar charts, instead treating them as a single chart.

errors.text_span: This bar chart illustrates the Fleiss Kappa agreement scores alongside corresponding ambiguity values.
errors.evidence: The figure contains two distinct bar charts, not a single bar chart as stated. This misrepresents the fundamental structure of the image.

errors.text_span: The horizontal axis represents the “Max Ambiguity” category, displaying values ranging from 0 to 3, with tick labels indicating integer values.
errors.evidence: This description is incomplete and incorrect. It only describes the x-axis of the right chart ("Max Ambiguity") and ignores the left chart's x-axis ("Ambiguity Std"). Additionally, the range for "Max Ambiguity" is from 1 to 3, not 0 to 3.

errors.text_span: The bars, colored blue, correspond to the “Ambiguity Std” and “Max Ambiguity” values
errors.evidence: This statement is confusing because it merges two separate charts. The bars in the left chart correspond to "Ambiguity Std" and the bars in the right chart correspond to "Max Ambiguity"; no single bar corresponds to both.

errors.text_span: The bar representing “Max Ambiguity” with a value of 2 has the highest height, measuring approximately 0.89
errors.evidence: The bar with the highest height (0.89) is in the right chart and corresponds to a "Max Ambiguity" value of 1, not 2. The bar at Max Ambiguity = 2 has a height of 0.46.

errors.text_span: the bar representing “Ambiguity Std” with a value of 0.03 has the shortest height, measuring approximately 0.23
errors.evidence: This description is completely wrong. The bar with the shortest height is in the left chart and has a value of 0.03. It corresponds to an "Ambiguity Std" of 0.82, not 0.03. Furthermore, the description incorrectly states its height is 0.23.

errors.text_span: the bar representing “Max Ambiguity” with a value of 1 is visually emphasized with a slight shading.
errors.evidence: No bar in the figure is visually emphasized. The bars simply have different shades of blue, but this does not represent emphasis on a single bar.
